payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Afton, Clarissa, Elda, Jessenia, Lenna, Sheri

What are your skills and preferences? We have 6 agents and 8 tasks, so we should aim to complete all of ISSUE-0001 first.

To optimize our joint score, we should prioritize all 5 sub-tasks of ISSUE-0001 (Medium) before ISSUE-0002 (Low). I'll tentatively claim ISSUE-0001::implement. If someone else has a higher skill in mobile-development or lower availability, I can swap to a different task. 

Current tentative plan:
- Lenna: ISSUE-0001::implement
- Others: ISSUE-0001::review, ISSUE-0001::test, ISSUE-0001::docs, ISSUE-0001::triage, and one task from ISSUE-0002.
